The season started with so low expectation. But so far it's far beyond Second Chance.

They took the risk to break the 4th wall with all the crew on camera for the emergency and it paid of: It gave a sense of urgency and mayhem fitting the theme. They build the Caleb-Tai relation with subtlety, and it gave an heavy emotional impact for this episode. Fitting the emotional theme of the episode, they cut all pretense of strategy, and gave the Debbie, Jason concern about their family. Not heavy handed at all, and very touching.

It is so perfect after S31 with all the gamebot around. And it is so much better than S30 with the girl doing monkey noise, and then being presented as the poor victim of bullies.

We can assume the rest of the season might be a bit boring with the domination woman-alliance the edit slowly build. But even in those 4 episode where nothing of note happen, the edit manages to keep us on our toes. Great TV.
